item.title: Alaska voters aren't ditching ranked choice voting, top-four primaries
item.description: This is the second time Alaskans voted down an effort to repeal the state's unique election system, which voters first approved in 2020. A repeal effort in 2024 also failed narrowly.

item.title: Telecom outage triggers rare nationwide FAA ground stop, stranding travelers
item.description: The rare nationwide ground stop, now lifted, paralyzed the U.S. air travel system Friday. Federal officials say telecommunication outages were to blame but offered few details.

item.title: Men on a mission: U2 is back, again. Are they cool this time?
item.description: Carnaval De Luz, the 16th album from the Irish rock band that's always on a mission, mines familiar terrain with good humor and a sense of urgency, and manages to meet the moment.

item.title: A new policy could help solve the U.S. organ shortage. Critics say it's unethical
